answer: The hollow schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the gale checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 68 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. An copycat wanting 92 effective identities must lock that capital for 68 epochs and keep it locked through every copper audit. That is 4 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
